summary: U-BX Technology Ltd. filed a prospectus supplement (Amendment No. 1 to Form 424B5) solely to correct a typographical error on the cover page. The amendment relates to a best-efforts offering of 15,166,668 units, each consisting of one Class A ordinary share and one warrant to purchase 0.3 share at $0.30 per unit. The warrants include a zero-exercise-price option expected to preclude cash proceeds. There is no special-situation event; the filing is an ordinary capital markets transaction correcting an inadvertent error.
